part: SQUATCHEE-SPIN mount v3 (PETG) — 6-finger button gripper + SOLID bayonet post (the split snap-post is gone), 2.0 mm walls
notes: v3 retention mechanism, after a field slicer-preview showed the v1/v2 split snap-post printing as two ~1 mm-thin, 6 mm-tall half-round towers with overhanging barb tips (tiny per-layer islands - unprintable garbage on real machines). Physics verdict: a snap prong needs LENGTH to flex within strain budget, printability needs SHORT+THICK - irreconcilable on this post. So the snap is GONE: the post is now a SOLID D4.4 column (13-15 mm^2 continuous layers fused to the D9.2 boss - perfect FDM) with a 45-deg tip chamfer and TWO kite-prism lug nubs (1.26 wide x 1.35 tall, protruding to r3.15, 48-deg self-supporting undersides, 29-deg up-facing tops) at z35.6, right above the root chamfer. The RETAINER (rigid again - PLA-safe) locks onto the lugs with a push-and-twist bayonet: drop in with its two L-windows aligned over the lugs, push to the stop, twist 34 deg - the lugs sit behind 0.95-tall solid ledges. Retention is GEOMETRIC (clearance fits, +-0.15-tolerance-proof - unlike any printed snap whose interference can vanish at loose extremes), proven by receipts: locked pose clear (0.149), pull-up locked INTERFERES (lug vs ledge, the negative control), pull-up untwisted lifts free (serviceable). Captive float 0.65 mm: rest = flange on prop hub (T=40.3), lug meets ledge at T=40.95; dual down-stop honesty: at adverse tolerances the lug can meet the window's far edge up to 0.3 before the flange lands (float grows to <=0.95, still <1.2 - benign, both stops are solid). Post tip (38.9) hides under the prop hub top (39.1) and clears the retainer ceiling by 0.2 at rest - at extremes the tip may touch first: a third solid axial stop, also benign. Walls: v2.3's 2.0 mm skirt/finger walls, D23.6 shell, ~3 mm dome, collar hoop, D9.2 boss - all unchanged (fingers L=18.4, snap-over strain <=1.72 percent wall-bound / 1.03 lip-model, snap-on force ~1.6-1.75x v1, stated honestly). Button cavity unchanged (lip D13.2, capture D14-D19, 47-deg roof cone apex 32.5 - now with a fully solid core under the boss, no mast-slot window). segments=132 (multiple of 6, facet-congruent slot cuts; also the grid that imprints the slot-roof cone notches cleanly - see v2.2/v2.3 arrangement notes in git history). Flat slot roofs z22.9 = micro-bridges (max true span 2.84 mm); steep_area == 0 is the support-free gate and the lug undersides are 48-deg BY CONSTRUCTION (45-deg diamonds flagged the gate; a horizontal round rod's belly flagged worse - the kite profile is the printable shape). Print orientation = modeled (fingers down, post up). NOT interchangeable with v1/v2 parts - v3 is a matched set.
